# CLI reference

`oa` is the command-line client of the REST API. For login, the config file and worked examples see [CLI](../integrations/cli.md). Global flags go before the command. Each command group below shows its usage as printed by `oa help`; commands that parse flags list them as printed by `oa COMMAND --help` (the flag package accepts both `-flag` and `--flag`).

## Usage

```text
oa [--server URL] [--token TOKEN] [--format table|json] <command> [args]
```

## Global flags

```text
--server    Server URL  (default: http://localhost:8080, env: OA_SERVER)
--token     API token   (env: OA_TOKEN)
--format    Output format: table|json  (default: table)
```

## Environment variables

| Variable | Named by |
|---|---|
| `OA_GPG_PASSPHRASE` | `oa gpg import` |
| `OA_SERVER` | `--server` |
| `OA_TOKEN` | `--token` |

## Auth

```text
auth login [--server URL] [--username U] [--password-stdin]
                                   Login with username/password (prompted without echo) or token
auth logout [--revoke --username U --password-stdin]
                                   Clear saved credentials (--revoke also revokes the server-side token)
auth whoami                        Show current user
auth passwd [--password-stdin]     Change your password (stdin: current, then new, one per line)
auth token list                    List your personal API tokens
auth token create --name N [--kind access|deploy] [--username U] [--password-stdin]
                                   Create a personal API token (signs in with your password)
auth token revoke <id> [--username U] [--password-stdin]
                                   Revoke a personal API token (signs in with your password)
```

## Repositories

```text
repo list                          List repositories
repo create <name> --format <fmt> [--description D] [--public] [--trash-retention-days N] [--immutable-releases] [--sign-packages]
                                   Create repository
repo show <name>                   Show repository details
repo update <name> [--description D] [--public[=false]] [--trash-retention-days N|default] [--immutable-releases[=false]] [--sign-packages[=false]]
                                   Update repository
repo delete <name> --confirm <name>  Delete repository (moved to the trash; prompts for the name on a terminal)
repo packages <name>               List packages in repository
repo members <name>                List the member repositories of a group repository
```

## Trash

```text
trash list [--repo NAME] [--kind K]  List trashed items (all: admin; --repo: repository delete permission)
trash restore <kind> <id> [--repo NAME]  Restore a trashed item or repository
trash purge <kind> <id> [--yes]    Permanently delete a trashed item now (admin)
```

### `oa trash`

```text
Usage: oa trash <list|restore|purge>
  oa trash purge <kind> <id> [--yes]            purge one item (admin)
  oa trash purge --repo NAME --all [--yes]      empty a repository's trash (repository manage permission)
```

## Artifacts

```text
artifact list <repo>               List packages in repository
artifact upload <repo> <file>      Upload a file; the repository format picks the endpoint, as for `oa upload` (files over 5 GiB switch to a multipart presigned upload)
artifact upload --presigned [--path P] [--content-type T] [--multipart] [--part-size SIZE] [--parallel N] <repo> <file>
                                   Upload a raw artifact straight to the object store (presigned PUT; files over 5 GiB,
                                   --multipart or --part-size (128M, 1G or bytes) upload in parts, --parallel 1-16, default 4)
artifact delete <repo> <id>        Delete artifact by ID
```

## Search

```text
search <query> [--repo R] [--fmt F]  Search artifacts
```

## Users (admin)

```text
user list                          List users
user create --username U --email E [--password-stdin]  Create user (password prompted without echo)
user show <id>                     Show user
user update <id> [--email E] [--full-name N] [--disabled[=false]]  Update user
user delete <id>                   Delete user
```

## Groups (admin)

```text
group list                         List groups
group create <name>                Create group
group show <id>                    Show group
group delete <id>                  Delete group
group members <id>                 List group members
group add-member <id> <user-id>    Add member to group
group rm-member <id> <user-id>     Remove member from group
```

## Projects

```text
project list                       List projects
project create <name>              Create a project
project show <name>                Show project (includes my_role)
project update <name> [--display-name N] [--description D]
                                   Update a project (owner); policy flags (--allowed-formats,
                                   --allowed-repo-types, --repo-name-prefix, --allow-public-repos,
                                   --max-repositories, --token-max-ttl-days) need a global admin
project delete <name>              Delete a project
project members <name>             List project members
project add-member <name> (<user-id> | --username U) [--role viewer|developer|maintainer|owner]
                                   Add member to a project
project set-role <name> <user-id> <role>
                                   Change a member's role
project rm-member <name> <user-id> Remove member from project
project groups <name>              List group grants
project add-group <name> <group-id|group-name> [--role viewer|developer|maintainer]
                                   Grant a group access
project rm-group <name> <group-id|group-name>
                                   Remove a group grant
```

## Tokens (admin)

```text
token list                         List all tokens
token revoke <id>                  Revoke any token
```

## GPG keys (admin)

```text
gpg list                           List GPG keys
gpg import --key <file|-> [--name N] [--passphrase-stdin] [--activate|--no-activate]
                                   Import a private key (passphrase: stdin or env OA_GPG_PASSPHRASE)
gpg generate [--name N] [--algorithm ed25519|rsa4096] [--user-name U] [--email E] [--comment C] [--activate|--no-activate]
                                   Generate a signing key
gpg delete <key> [--force]         Delete a key (id, name or fingerprint)
gpg activate <key> [--repository R]    Make key the signer (global or per deb/rpm repo)
gpg deactivate <key> [--repository R]  Stop using key for signing
gpg export <key> [--output FILE]   Export the public key
```

## Storage backends (admin)

```text
storage list                       List storage backends
storage create --name N [--type T] [--config-file F|-]
                                   Create storage backend (credentials via --config-file, - = stdin)
storage show <name>                Show storage backend
storage update <name> [--config-file F|-]  Update storage backend
storage delete <name>              Delete storage backend
storage test <name>                Test storage backend
```

## Backup & restore (admin)

```text
backup list                        List backups
backup create [--type full|metadata-only]  Create backup
backup show <id>                   Show backup
backup download <id> <dest>        Download backup
backup restore <archive-file>      Restore from a downloaded backup archive
```

## Audit log (admin)

```text
audit list [--limit N] [--action A] [--actor A]  List audit entries
audit export [--format jsonl|csv] [--since T] [--until T] [--actor A] [--action A] [-o FILE]
                                   Export the audit log (default: jsonl to stdout)
```

## Webhooks

```text
webhook list                       List global webhooks
webhook create --name N --url U --events E,E [--secret-file F] [--active=false]  Create webhook
webhook show <id>                  Show webhook
webhook update <id> [--name N] [--url U] [--events E,E] [--active[=false]]  Update webhook
webhook delete <id>                Delete webhook
webhook test <id>                  Test webhook
webhook deliveries <id>            List webhook deliveries
webhook repo list <repo>           List repo webhooks
webhook repo create <repo> --name N --url U --events E,E [--secret-file F]  Create repo webhook
```

## SBOM

```text
sbom list <repo>                   List SBOMs for repository
sbom generate <repo> --artifact-id ID [--format cyclonedx|spdx|spdx-json|spdx3-json] [--spec-version V]
                                   Generate an SBOM for one artifact (CycloneDX 1.4-1.6, SPDX 2.3)
sbom show <repo> <id>              Show SBOM
sbom download <repo> <id> <dest> [--attest true|bundle]   Download SBOM (or its signed attestation)
sbom delete <repo> <id>            Delete SBOM
vex get <repo> [--artifact-id ID] [--format openvex|cyclonedx] [--spec-version V] [--output FILE] [--attest true|bundle]
                                   VEX document of an artifact or the whole repository (stdout without --output)
vex list <repo> [--artifact-id ID] List recorded VEX decisions
vex set <repo> --artifact-id ID --vuln CVE --status S [--justification J] [--impact TEXT] [--action TEXT]
                                   Record a VEX decision (not_affected requires --justification)
vex delete <repo> <id>             Delete a VEX decision
dtrack show|test|pushes <repo>     Dependency-Track integration of a repository
dtrack push <repo> --artifact-id ID   Push an artifact to Dependency-Track
```

## Vulnerability scanning

```text
vuln scan <repo> --artifact-id ID --package P --version V --ecosystem E [--scanner osv|trivy|grype]
                                   Scan one package for vulnerabilities
vuln list <repo>                   List vulnerability scans
vuln show <repo> <id>              Show vulnerability scan
vuln quarantine <repo> <id> [--release]
                                   Quarantine the vulnerable package (--release lifts it)
vuln delete <repo> <id>            Delete vulnerability scan
```

## License scanning

```text
license scan <repo> --artifact-id ID  Scan one artifact for license issues
license list <repo>                List license scans
license show <repo> <id>           Show license scan
```

## Secret scanning

```text
secret scan <repo> --artifact-id ID [--content-file F|-]  Scan one artifact (and optional content) for secrets
secret list <repo>                 List secret scans
secret show <repo> <id>            Show secret scan
secret quarantine <repo> <id> [--release]
                                   Quarantine the package (--release lifts it)
secret delete <repo> <id>          Delete secret scan
```

## Cleanup policies

```text
cleanup list <repo>                List cleanup policies
cleanup create <repo> --name N [--keep-count N] [--keep-days N] [--name-pattern RE] [--schedule CRON] [--enabled=false]
                                   Create cleanup policy (needs --keep-count or --keep-days)
cleanup show <repo> <id>           Show cleanup policy
cleanup update <repo> <id> [same flags]  Update cleanup policy
cleanup delete <repo> <id>         Delete cleanup policy
cleanup run <repo> <id>            Run cleanup policy now
```

## Storage quotas

```text
quota show <repo>                  Show repository quota
quota set <repo> [--limit N --unit MB|GB|TB] [--max-artifacts N] [--warn-percent P]  Set quota
quota delete <repo>                Remove quota
```

## Artifact properties

```text
props list <repo> <artifact-id>    List artifact properties
props set <repo> <artifact-id> <key> <value>  Set property
props delete <repo> <artifact-id> <key>       Delete property
props search <repo> <key> <value>  Search artifacts by property
```

## CI (see docs/integrations/ci.md)

```text
upload <repo> <file|glob>... [--target-path P] [--flat] [--property k=v]... [--build-name N] [--build-number M] [--build-url U] [--vcs-revision SHA]
                                   Upload files to a deb/ivy/maven/raw/rpm/sbt repository and set build properties
bundle create <name> <version> [--description D] [--pipeline P]
                                   Create a draft release bundle
bundle add <name> <version> --repo R --path P... | --from-build NAME/NUMBER [--repo R]...
                                   Add artifacts to a draft bundle, by path or by the build that produced them
bundle seal <name> <version> [--gpg-key K]  Seal a bundle (optionally sign its manifest)
bundle show <name> <version>       Show a bundle and its items
promote <name> <version> --stage S [--target-repo R] [--notes T]
                                   Promote a sealed bundle to a pipeline stage
```

### `oa bundle`

```text
Usage: oa bundle <create|add|seal|show> <name> <version> [flags]
  oa bundle create <name> <version> [--description D] [--pipeline P]
  oa bundle add <name> <version> --repo R --path P... | --from-build NAME/NUMBER [--repo R]...
  oa bundle seal <name> <version> [--gpg-key K]
  oa bundle show <name> <version>
```

## Migration

```text
import nexus|artifactory|openartifact --source-url URL --repo SRC[:DST]... [--dry-run] [--create-repos]
                                   [--concurrency N] [--state-file F]  Import from Nexus / Artifactory / a 0.14 OpenArtifact (--all for every hosted repository)
import config openartifact --source-url URL --output DIR [--kind K]...
                                   Write oa apply manifests and a mapping report from a 0.14 OpenArtifact
```

## Declarative configuration (admin)

```text
apply -f FILE|DIR|- [-R] [--kind K] [--prune|--prune-all] [--force-secrets] [--continue-on-error] [--validate-only] [-o json]
                                   Make the server match the YAML manifests
diff  -f FILE|DIR|- [-R] [--kind K] [--prune|--prune-all] [-o json]
                                   Show what apply would change (exit 0 none, 2 changes, 1 error)
export [--kind K] [--with-members] [-o DIR]
                                   Write the current configuration as manifests
```

## Package deltas

```text
delta list <repo> <pkg-id>         List available deltas for package
delta get <repo> <pkg-id> --from <sha256> <dest>  Download delta patch
```

## System

```text
system info                        Show system information
```

## Utility

```text
version                            Show CLI version (--format json for machine use)
help                               Show this help
```
